drivingQuestion: How can her bed in his house acquire the bill of divorce for her?
outcomeNote: The bed is its own domain, so the baraita does not decide the buyer's-vessel dispute.

segments.he: לָא צְרִיכָא, דְּגָבוֹהַּ עֲשָׂרָה. וְהָאִיכָּא מְקוֹם כַּרְעֵי! אַמְּקוֹם כַּרְעֵי לָא קָפְדִי אִינָשֵׁי.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: «No,» it is «necessary» to state this halakha in a case «where» the bed is «ten» handbreadths «high,» as then the bed is considered to be its own domain. The Gemara challenges this: «But there is the place» on which the «legs» of the bed are standing; the legs are standing in the husband’s domain. The Gemara answers: «People are not particular» about «the place of the legs» of the bed since it is so small. Therefore, since the bed is considered to be its own domain, it is not considered to be within the domain of the husband.
